# telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_numbers (Data Source)

Lists display identity record phone numbers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_number`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dir_id` (String) The dir id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `display_identity_record_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_identity_record_phone_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--display_identity_record_phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_identity_record_phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `batch_id` (String) Id of the batch this number was vetted as part of.
- `created_at` (String)
- `dir_id` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the Letter of Authorization document attached to this number's batch.
- `phone_number` (String) E.164 with leading `+`.
- `rejection_reason` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_identity_record_phone_numbers--rejection_reason))
- `status` (String) Phone-number lifecycle status. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing the batch this number belongs to. - `verified` - approved; the DIR's display identity will be shown on outbound calls from this number. - `unsuccessful` - Telnyx rejected this submission; the customer may re-add to retry. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim on the DIR). - `expired` - verification expired; re-add to renew. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be re-added on this or any other DIR you own.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--display_identity_record_phone_numbers--rejection_reason"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_identity_record_phone_numbers.rejection_reason`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `detail` (String)
- `message` (String) Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
- `title` (String)
